mavzu: Unit 3: What is your speciality?. Lesson 2.B. Job interview

savollar.savol: CV so'zi nimani anglatadi?
Matnda "advert" so'zi qaysi ma'noni bildiradi?
Matnga ko'ra, intervyuda birinchi necha soniya juda muhim hisoblanadi?
Matnga ko'ra, yaxshi taassurot qoldirish uchun nima qilish kerak?
variantlar: Professional kiyinish va qattiq qo'l berish

savollar.savol: Matndagi qahramon intervyuga qanday kiyim kiygan?
variantlar: Smart kostyum, oq ko'ylak va qizil tufli

savollar.savol: Matnga ko'ra, intervyu yakunida intervyuerlar nima deydi?
"Should" so'zi asosan nima uchun ishlatiladi?
Matnda "fill out the application form" iborasi nimani bildiradi?
Matnga ko'ra, intervyu paytida qahramondan nima haqida so'ralgan?
variantlar: Oldingi ish tajribasi va ko'nikmalari haqida

savollar.savol: Matnga ko'ra, intervyudan oldin qahramon o'zini qanday his qildi?
"the interviewer / call / earlier" so'zlaridan to'g'ri maslahat jumlasini aniqlang.
variantlar: The interviewer should call you earlier.
You call should the interviewer earlier.
You should call the interviewer earlier.
You shouldn't call the interviewer earlier.

savollar.savol: "be / the interview / late" so'zlaridan qaysi jumla to'g'ri maslahat beradi?
variantlar: You should be late for the interview.
You shouldn't be late for the interview.

savollar.savol: Do'stingiz "I'm not going to fill in an application form" dedi. Unga qanday maslahat berasiz?
variantlar: You shouldn't fill in the application form.
You shouldn't go to the interview.
You should fill in the application form.
You should call the company instead.

savollar.savol: Do'stingiz "I'm going to put on my best T-shirt and shorts" dedi. Unga qanday maslahat berasiz?
variantlar: You shouldn't go to the interview at all.

savollar.savol: Matnga ko'ra, qahramon ish topish uchun birinchi nima qildi?
"Have you got any questions?" savolini odatda kim beradi?
Dialogga ko'ra, ish beruvchi qancha ish haqi to'laydi?
Dialogga ko'ra, nomzod qaysi kunlar ishlaydi?
"We'll be in touch" iborasi intervyu natijasi haqida nimani bildiradi?
Matndagi qahramon nega o'zini yaxshi tayyorlangan deb o'yladi?
variantlar: U savollarga javob berishga tayyor bo'lgan va kiyimiga ahamiyat bergan

savollar.savol: Do'stingiz aytdi: "People are always leaving this company, so I'll say they must need somebody." Bu fikrni intervyuda aytish nega yaxshi maslahat emas?
variantlar: Chunki bu kompaniya haqida salbiy fikr bildirish bo'lib, yomon taassurot qoldiradi
Chunki bu to'g'ri va albatta ishga olinadi

savollar.savol: Matndagi qahramonning intervyudan keyin "it went well" deb o'ylashiga sabab bo'lgan asosiy omillarni aniqlang.
variantlar: Yaxshi tayyorlangani va savollarga to'liq javob bergani

savollar.savol: Agar nomzod ishga erta boshlashni xohlasa va buni "Straight away!" deb javob bersa, bu intervyuerning qaysi savoliga javob bo'ladi?
variantlar: "Do you work well in a team?"

savollar.savol: "hardworking / be / responsible" so'zlaridan to'g'ri va mantiqan maslahat jumlasini tuzing.
variantlar: You shouldn't be hardworking and responsible.
You should be hardworking and responsible.

savollar.savol: Nomzod "I like working together with other people" deb javob berdi. Bu qaysi savolga javob ekanligini aniqlang.
variantlar: "Do you work well in a team?"

savollar.savol: Matn va dialogni solishtirib, ikkisida ham intervyu jarayonida umumiy bo'lgan narsani aniqlang.
variantlar: Ikkisida ham nomzod ishga qabul qilinmaydi
Ikkisida ham nomzod ish haqi so'raydi va hech qanday savolga javob bermaydi
Ikkisida ham nomzoddan oldingi ish tajribasi va ko'nikmalari haqida so'raladi
Ikkisida ham intervyu telefon orqali o'tkaziladi

savollar.savol: "during / the questions / the interview / fully / answer" so'zlaridan to'g'ri maslahatni tuzing.
variantlar: You should answer the questions fully during the interview.
You should the questions answer fully during interview.
You shouldn't answer the questions during the interview.
The interview should answer fully during the questions.

savollar.savol: Nomzod "this is a good organisation to work for" va "the hours are good for me" deb aytdi. Bu uning qaysi savolga bergan javobi va nima uchun bu yaxshi javob hisoblanadi?
variantlar: "Have you got any questions?" - chunki savol bergan
"What skills have you got?" - chunki ko'nikmalarini sanab o'tgan
"When could you start?" - chunki vaqtni aytgan
"Why do you want this job?" - chunki sabablarini aniq va ijobiy tushuntirgan

savollar.savol: Matndagi qahramon va dialogdagi nomzodni solishtiring: ikkisi ham intervyuga qanday yondashgan?
variantlar: Ikkisi ham savollarga javob berishdan bosh tortgan
Ikkisi ham tayyorgarlik ko'rgan va ijobiy natija kutgan
Ikkisi ham tayyorgarliksiz borgan va yomon natija kutgan

savollar.savol: "clothes / wear / casual" so'zlaridan tuzilgan maslahat va matndagi qahramonning kiyinishini solishtiring, qaysi xulosa to'g'ri?
variantlar: Qahramon casual kiyim kiygan, bu maslahatga zid
Maslahat va qahramonning kiyinishi bog'liq emas
Qahramon smart kiyim kiygan, bu "You shouldn't wear casual clothes" maslahatiga mos keladi
